Select molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested against the target deoxynucleoside triphosphate triphosphohydrolase in assays performed on human cells. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary. Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to match the specified target and assays.assay_organism to match 'Homo sapiens'. Require canonical_smiles via an INNER JOIN to compound_structures. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
